description: Step 0: fetches the corrected <mediaId>.png files from ptoneuxpcimagestoreprd/manual-upload-images (root only), checks ETag, Content-MD5 and PNG header, freezes them in a fresh work dir. A later run of the same job reuses them. Writes nothing to Azure.

params.label: Job id
params.description: Name of this job (letters, digits, . _ -). Empty: a 'Job:' line in the task, else the UTC timestamp. Give the same job id to continue a job (e.g. with its approval).

params.label: Work dir
params.description: Local folder of this job (outside Git). Empty: a 'Work dir:' line in the task, else ~/oneux-image-replacements/<job>.
